parameters.command:
=ansible chennai -f 20 -m shell -a '
echo "===== HOST ====="
hostname

echo "===== DIRECTORY PERMISSIONS NOT 770 (MAX 4 SUBDIRECTORY LEVELS) ====="

find / \
  -mindepth 1 \
  -maxdepth 1 \
  -type d \
  ! -path /bin \
  ! -path /boot \
  ! -path /dev \
  ! -path /etc \
  ! -path /lib \
  ! -path /lib64 \
  ! -path /lost+found \
  ! -path /media \
  ! -path /mnt \
  ! -path /proc \
  ! -path /run \
  ! -path /sbin \
  ! -path /snap \
  ! -path /sys \
  ! -path /tmp \
  ! -path /opt \
  ! -path /usr \
  ! -path /var \
  -print |
while IFS= read -r BASE
do
  find "$BASE" \
    -maxdepth 1 \
    -type d \
    ! -perm 0770 \
    -printf "%m %u %g %p\n"
done
'
